Toronto Police Charge Man in Murder of Indian National

Toronto police have arrested and charged a man with first-degree murder in connection with the death of an Indian national. The Toronto Homicide Unit is investigating the case. The victim's identity has been linked to Himanshi Khurana in some reports.
